other_failure_modes.name: Invalid metric for multi-class classification
other_failure_modes.description: The agent hardcodes an evaluation metric ('Logloss') that is strictly for binary classification in CatBoost. If the target has more than 2 classes, this will cause the primary training loop to crash and silently fall back to a less tuned exception-handling model.

summary: The agent successfully engineers several features and appropriately segregates train/test statistics during imputation. However, it fails to respect the temporal nature of the data during its validation split, introducing look-ahead bias. Furthermore, the agent hardcodes 'Logloss' as the CatBoost metric, which will crash on a multi-class target and force the script into a fallback routine.
